phaseA.intent: cold cache + polling off: every category is a live provider fetch (miss envelope)

phaseB.intent: poller enabled: the init poll warms all eleven keys and a GET is served from the warmed key

phaseC.intent: one provider feed fails: only that key stays uncached and a later poll caches it

phaseD.intent: close(): the interval is cleared, so no further provider fetches happen after shutdown

phaseE.intent: live provider payloads -> the original consumer (parseXml + newsParse): headers dropped, images resolved
